en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from the one who mentioned it, from Hafs Bin Umar, from Salim, from Abu Baseer,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘The one who prevents a carat of Zakāt, so let him die, if he so desires to as a Jew, or a Christian’.
en.sarwar: 14. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from those whom he has mentioned from Hafs ibn ‘Umar from Salim from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
one (Muslim) who does not pay zakat dies as a Jew or a Christian; (he is given the chance to choose).”
